units.text: INT. SUBURBAN KITCHEN - NIGHT
Dark.
A power cut.
One camping lantern on the island.
A handheld radio crackles beside it.
THE WOMAN (40s, wet coat) stands in the doorway.
ASH (30s) holds a kitchen knife, shaking.

You came through the back door. The back door has been locked since Tuesday. Tell me how that happens. Tell me, and use small words, because I have been awake since the sky went green, and they are tired.
units.name: ASH

units.text: I didn't open it. It was already open.
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: Ash? Ash, do you copy? The grid's not coming back. Repeat, not coming back.
units.name: RADIO

units.text: Copy, Mum. Stay in the cellar.
units.name: ASH
paren: not taking their eyes off her

units.text: I'm not here to hurt anyone. My name is Delphine. I was in the lab when it started. I know what's in the sky, and I know why the lights went. I have forty minutes of explanation and you have, what, a bread knife?
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: It's a good bread knife.
units.name: ASH

units.text: I believe you.
units.name: DELPHINE

units.text: The lantern flickers.
Out.
On.
Ash. There's someone at the window.
units.name: RADIO

units.text: Ash looks.
Delphine looks.
Nothing but black glass.
Tell me everything. Start with what you did.
units.name: ASH
